documents.title: Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Appointment of Statutory Auditor/s

analysis.summary: Premier Polyfilm Limited reported a robust financial performance for the fiscal year 2025-2026, with net profit surging 22.60% to ₹3,188 lakhs and gross sales reaching ₹34,126 lakhs. Production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products increased to 29,311 metric tonnes driven by enhanced capacity utilization and strategic cost management. The company secured an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park for expansion and commenced logistics and trading activities there. Additionally, management recommended a dividend of 15% (₹0.15 per equity share) for the financial year. Premier Polyfilm Limited published its Annual Report providing details on various resolutions, including the adoption of financial statements, declaration of dividends, re-appointment and remuneration of executive directors, and appointment of auditors.

demand_outlook.claim: The company focused its operations on high-demand, high-profitability product categories.
demand_outlook.quote: The Company successfully implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at highly competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's products continue to be in demand.
demand_outlook.quote: By introducing above R&D formulations has helped the company to reduce cost of new range of colour schemes and designs of finished products the Company’s products continue to be in demand.

capex_expansion.claim: The company secured and took possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has secured and taken possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park and that the Company has commenced logistics and trading activities at the new unit and the billing process has also started.

capex_expansion.claim: An order was placed for manufacturing PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machines.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, the Company has placed an order for manufacturing of PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine and the advance payment for the same has been made.

capex_expansion.claim: The company installed and utilized new plant and machinery to achieve higher capacity utilization.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company achieved higher capacity utilization with the installation and utilization of new Plant & Machinery.

margins_costs.claim: The company implemented a strategy of procuring raw materials at competitive prices.
margins_costs.quote: The Company successfully implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at highly competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods.

margins_costs.claim: Product lines with sub-optimal margins were strategically discontinued.
margins_costs.quote: This was complemented by the strategic discontinuation of product lines with sub-optimal margins, allowing for a concentrated focus on high-demand, high-profitability categories.

margins_costs.claim: The increase in cash profit was mainly due to arranging raw material at cheaper rates and keeping finished goods prices unchanged.
margins_costs.quote: The reasons for increase in cash profit during the current quarter and year ended on 31st March,2024 was mainly due to that company could arrange raw material at cheaper rate and sold the finished goods at existing sales prices i.e. the prices of finished goods were not changed/devalued.

margins_costs.claim: Finance costs were reduced to some extent by arranging a cheaper loan from Yes Bank Limited.
margins_costs.quote: Secondly productions of some of the items of finished goods which were not generated good profits were stopped and to some extent company could arrange cheaper loan from other bank i.e. Yes Bank Limited and hence finance cost was also reduced.

orders_capacity.claim: Production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products grew to 29,311 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational excellence was a key highlight, with production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products growing to 29,311 metric tonnes from 28,383 metric tonnes in the prior year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company produced 27,133 metric tonnes of PVC flooring, sheetings, films, etc., during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: During the period under review your company produced 27,133 M.T. of PVC flooring, Sheetings, Films etc. as against 26,755 M.T. produced during the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a dividend of 15% amounting to ₹0.15 per equity share for the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Encouraged by the performance of the company, The Board of your company is pleased to recommend for your approval Payment of dividend @ 0.15 per equity share of Rs.1/- each (i.e. 15%) for the year ended on 31st March,2026 subject to deduction of Tax at Source

capital_allocation.claim: The board transferred an amount of ₹400 lakhs to general reserves.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Board has transferred an amount of Rs. 400/- Lakh to General Reserves.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a dividend of 15% amounting to Rs. 0.75 per equity share.
capital_allocation.quote: Encouraged by the performance of the company, The Board of your company is pleased to recommend for your approval Payment of dividend @ 0.75 per equity share of Rs.5/- each (i.e. 15%) for the year ended on 31st March,2024 subject to deduction of Tax at Source

risks_headwinds.claim: The company received a notice from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited regarding delay in uploading related party transaction disclosures.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the year under review, the Company received a notice from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) regarding non-compliance with the provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”) due to delay in uploading the Integrated Filing (XBRL) containing Related Party Transaction disclosures under Regulation 23(9) of the SEBI Listing Regulations on the NEAPS portal.

risks_headwinds.claim: A penalty of ₹50,000 was imposed by NSE due to a delay caused by technical issues on the portal.
risks_headwinds.quote: The delay occurred due to technical issues encountered on the NSE portal. The Company submitted an application seeking waiver of the penalty imposed; however, the waiver application was not accepted by NSE. Accordingly, NSE imposed a fine of ₹50,000/- vide its order dated 16th February, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Lower profitability was experienced in the past due to economic slowdown and adverse market conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Due to economic slowdown and consequent adverse market conditions prevailing, there was lower profitability in the Company.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production through the newly ordered PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.
management_commitments.quote: The commercial production through the said machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to fully switch to sustainable and renewable sources of power such as solar and PNG energy during the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Seeing the Government inclination towards pollution free environment and as per various notifications of Government in this regard,your Company plans to fully switch other sustainable and renewable sources of power/energy such as Solar and PNG energy inaddition to available current source of power energy available with the company during the current financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
